Dear River Cleanup team,

I am applying for the Junior Corporate Partnership Officer role. Your mission to free rivers from plastic deeply resonates with me, and I want to contribute to the operational backbone that makes corporate partnerships thrive.

At Episto, I manage client websites and SEO, but I also maintain CRM records and follow-up for a cleaning-services client, ensuring data accuracy and timely communication. I have built and optimized WordPress sites, run technical audits, and produced performance reports—skills that translate directly to partnership administration, CRM super-user tasks, and reporting. I am structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable coordinating multiple workstreams.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp, and available to start asap. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your corporate partnerships team.

Warm regards,

cover_letter:
Dear River Cleanup team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Corporate Partnership Officer position. Your vision of plastic-free rivers and the Clean River Model's systemic approach inspire me, and I want to bring my operational and digital skills to your corporate partnerships team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage client websites and SEO, but I also maintain CRM records and follow-up for a cleaning-services client. This hands-on CRM experience, combined with my ability to keep multiple workstreams moving, aligns with the role's focus on accurate data, timely follow-up, and smooth coordination. I have built and maintained WordPress sites, run technical SEO/GEO audits, and produced performance reports using Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs—tools that sharpen my analytical and reporting capabilities. My project mirook.com further demonstrates my structured approach to website management and visibility.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp, and fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level (currently improving). I am eager to learn and grow in corporate partnerships, and I thrive in fast-paced environments. I am confident that my attention to detail, service-oriented mindset, and problem-solving skills will allow me to support your team effectively.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to River Cleanup's mission. Thank you for your consideration.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
